title: DECISION: Receiver Behavior resolves effective preference by reference to Sender Behavior rule
description:
Choice: The Receiver Behavior section says 'using the same rule as the Sender Behavior' rather than restating the Chat.receiptSharing / PresenceStatus.receiptSharing lookup logic verbatim.

Why good: Avoids duplication of the preference-resolution rule in two places. A single authoritative statement in Sender Behavior is cross-referenced; if the rule ever changes it changes in one place. Restating it would risk the two copies drifting.

Alternatives avoided: Copying the full resolution logic into Receiver Behavior (duplication/drift risk); factoring it into a named sub-section (correct but heavier than needed for a two-branch rule).
